description: This PHP class 'TimesheetDecorator' is part of the OrangeHRM system, acting as a decorator for the 'Timesheet' entity. It provides formatted accessors for timesheet dates, a method to associate an employee by employee number, and a method to retrieve the timesheet's state in a human-readable format. It utilizes traits for common functionality and operates within the 'OrangeHRM\Entity\Decorator' namespace.

classes.name: TimesheetDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for 'Timesheet' entities, providing formatted getter methods for date fields, a method to associate an employee by employee number, and a method to retrieve the timesheet's state in a readable format.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a Timesheet object.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted start date of the timesheet.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted end date of the timesheet.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmployeeNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with the timesheet based on employee number.

methods.name: getTimesheetState
methods.description: Returns the human-readable state of the timesheet.
